description_en: Interval in milliseconds at which credentials should be refreshed (when using [`apiKeyHelper`](/en/settings#available-settings))
description_ja: `apiKeyHelper`を使用して認証情報を取得する際の更新間隔(ミリ秒単位)を設定します。
use_case_ja:
- 短期間で期限が切れる一時的なAPIキーを生成するカスタムスクリプトを使用している場合に、リフレッシュ頻度を調整できます。
- デフォルト(5分または401エラー時)以外のタイミングで、バックグラウンドでのキー更新を制御したい場合に利用します。
doc_snippets: If you've set the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR environment variable on Linux or Windows, the file lives under that directory instead. Supported authentication types : Claude.ai credentials, Claude API credentials, Azure Auth, Bedrock Auth, and Vertex Auth. Custom credential scripts : the apiKeyHelper setting can be configured to run a shell script that s an API key. Refresh intervals : by default, apiKeyHelper is called after 5 minutes or on HTTP 401 response. Set CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS environment variable for custom refresh intervals. Slow helper notice : if apiKeyHelper takes longer than 10 seconds to a key, Claude Code displays a warning notice in the prompt bar showing the elapsed time. If you see this notice regularly, check whether your credential script can be optimized. apiKeyHelper , ANTHROPIC_API_KEY , and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN apply to terminal CLI sessions only. Claude Desktop and remote sessions use OAuth exclusively and do not call apiKeyHelper or read API key environment variables.
